name: Saeki Arisa
source:
She is a senior at the school and is loved by all the students because of her energetic, cheerful, and caring personality,

She has known the main character and Miku since they served on the school festival committee. It's winter and she is about to graduate, but she still hasn't decided what to do.

[From [url=https://palette.clearrave.co.jp/product/kimikoi/chara.htm]official site[/url]]
